scientific.integrity: The infinite classification is proved symbolically. Exact cyclotomic computation for translation-normalized minors at p=3 and p=5 is corroborative rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to three-by-three minors of the cyclic Fourier matrix of order the square of an odd prime; no claim is made for larger minors, higher prime powers, or arbitrary composite orders.

title: All singular three-by-three minors of prime-square Fourier matrices
